narrative.intro: Noridian Healthcare Solutions reported $329M in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Noridian Healthcare Solutions obligated funds across 7 awards, with an average award size of $47M. Noridian Healthcare Solutions obligations are up 39.2% year over year. Noridian Healthcare Solutions fiscal-year history shows fluctuation: FY21 totaled $324M, FY22 totaled $291M, FY23 totaled $154M, FY24 totaled $252M, FY25 totaled $236M, and FY26 totaled $329M. Noridian Healthcare Solutions receives the bulk of obligations in the Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers market, which totaled $292M in FY2026 to date. Noridian Healthcare Solutions also reported $36.9M in the All Other Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services market and $0 in Computer Systems Design Services. The current-year totals are partial, covering the fiscal year to date. This snapshot helps contractors and procurement analysts see Noridian Healthcare Solutions scale, the concentration in health insurance services, and the recent rebound in obligations compared with prior years.

sections.heading: How have Noridian Healthcare Solutions obligations trended year over year?
sections.body: Noridian Healthcare Solutions obligations are up 39.2% year over year. Noridian Healthcare Solutions posted $329M in FY26, up from $236M in FY25 and $252M in FY24. Noridian Healthcare Solutions experienced a low point at $154M in FY23 before rising again through FY24 and FY25 into FY26. Noridian Healthcare Solutions current-year total is a fiscal-year-to-date figure.
